mechanism.claim: A directional opening-hour drive that establishes a fresh range, followed by seven completed hours whose closes never surrender the opening-range midpoint and whose terminal close extends the opening boundary, represents sustained initiative price discovery. Follow that accepted direction for eight hours when the completed block has elevated realized variation.
mechanism.side: long after an upward opening drive with midpoint hold and upper extension; short after the symmetric downward drive
mechanism.why_distinct: Opening-range failure trades rejection in three two-hour phases; break-retest uses a preceding four-hour range and explicit later retest; inside-resolution begins with containment. HVODHR requires a one-hour initiative drive, seven-hour close-by-close midpoint preservation, and terminal extension within one completed block, with no volume, flow, funding, OI, cross-asset, fitted outcome, prior event, or control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the full completed eight-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three daily opening-drive acceptance clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.opening_drive: first 60 rows; opening high=max high, low=min low, midpoint=(high+low)/2, direction=sign(last close-first open), strict nonzero
features.long_acceptance: opening direction positive, every acceptance-window minute close>opening midpoint, and terminal close>opening high
features.short_acceptance: opening direction negative, every acceptance-window minute close<opening midpoint, and terminal close<opening low
features.ambiguity: exactly one acceptance side must hold
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute log(close/open) returns across [D-8h,D)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.eligible_state: accepted opening drive and variation gate pass

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: opening-hour initiative followed by seven-hour close-by-close midpoint preservation and extension

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no drive, range, midpoint, preservation, extension, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.
